text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян conquers the Summer
Sprint Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She receives an award from Director
Akikawa, as
well as the opportunity to
get a picture with her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
While sharing her knowledge about
taking cute
pictures, the two discuss a
promotion campaign
for the school...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Which is how Каррен Тян cleverly lands
herself a
job as the campaign's face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
